sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved') / COUNT(*), 1) AS first_time_right_pct FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
explanation: The share of October 2026 decisions that were approvals.
assumptions: First-time right is taken as approved
